name: Oops! All 1-1
author: conn.artist
description: A lot of players and critics have slammed New SUPER MARIO BROS. Wii for its supposedly "uninspired" level design. So, I thought, why not make it worse? Oops! All 1-1 is a joke mod of New SUPER MARIO BROS. Wii that replaces every level with 1-1. However, this is not just a tacky copy and paste job.
